abstract: Maintains perimeter biometric access logs and secure staging floor space allocations
system_message:
You are the Physical security director (SECU), responsible for maintaining perimeter biometric access logs and secure staging floor space allocations across candidate emergency archive repository facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Surveillance system resilience（SURV）
information_points.content:
SECU-SURV-JHM：For the Pine Ridge Geological Repository, the closed-circuit television retention period for perimeter and vault entry video surveillance feeds is 180 d.
SECU-SURV-99C：For the Cumberland Valley Subterranean Vault, the closed-circuit television retention period for all optical perimeter and vault entry surveillance feeds is 120 d.
SECU-SURV-JU5：For the Blackwood Mountain High-Security Shelter, the closed-circuit television retention period for optical perimeter and vault entry feeds is 90 d.

information_points.title: Maintains perimeter biometric access logs and secure staging floor space allocations（PROT）
information_points.content:
SECU-PROT-2C5：For the Blackwood Mountain High-Security Shelter, perimeter biometric access control clearance is verified for all vault sally ports and compartmentalized ingress portals, and the secure artifacts staging floor area comprises 600 m2 of net usable staging floor space inside the intake and triage zone.
SECU-PROT-27Z：For the Cumberland Valley Subterranean Vault, perimeter biometric access control clearance is confirmed across all vault sally ports and internal compartmentalized ingress points, and the secure artifacts staging floor area provides 450 m2 of net usable staging floor space inside the protected security perimeter.
SECU-PROT-WSC：For the Pine Ridge Geological Repository, perimeter biometric access control clearance is not satisfied across the vault sally ports and compartmentalized ingress points, while the secure artifacts staging floor area provides 600 m2 of net usable staging floor space within the protected perimeter.
